name: Ragefire Chasm (Classic)
summary: Beneath Orgrimmar, Ragefire Chasm puts the city at risk as troggs break into its tunnels. Its fiery caverns also shelter a cult with plans beyond Durotar.

sections.title: A Hidden Peril
sections.body: Ragefire troggs have pushed into the volcanic tunnels beneath Orgrimmar. They rose from deep fissures and now threaten the city's foundations. Magatha Grimtotem, a tauren, tried to make peace with them, but they answered with violence. Their tunnels run beneath stone streets and fortified towers. If the creatures keep digging upward, Orgrimmar itself is at risk.

sections.title: The Searing Blade
sections.body: The Searing Blade serves the demonic Shadow Council beneath Orgrimmar. Three figures lead the cult: Taragaman the Hungerer, a felguard; Jergosh the Invoker, an orc warlock; and Bazzalan, a satyr. They seek to undo all that Thrall's Horde has established in Durotar. Warchief Thrall watches their activities and hopes their overconfidence will expose the Shadow Council's higher leaders.

faq.q: Where is the entrance to Ragefire Chasm?
faq.answer: You reach Ragefire Chasm through the Cleft of Shadow, a subterranean canyon deep within Orgrimmar. Its entrance lies near the tent of Neeru Fireblade, an orc warlock.

faq.q: Why are there troggs beneath Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Ragefire troggs rose from ancient, deep cavern systems beneath Durotar and broke into the volcanic depths under Orgrimmar. They threaten the capital's structure and its people, and have refused every attempt at peaceful containment.

faq.q: Why does Thrall allow cultists to live under the capital?
aliases: why is searing blade under orgrimmar
faq.answer: Warchief Thrall knows the cultists are beneath Orgrimmar and keeps them under close watch. He hopes they will reveal the identity and whereabouts of the Shadow Council's true leaders.

faq.q: Who leads the cultists inside the chasm?
faq.answer: Three figures lead the Searing Blade in Ragefire Chasm: Taragaman the Hungerer, a formidable felguard; Jergosh the Invoker, an orc warlock; and Bazzalan, a satyr.

angles.text: As Horde, you defend your homeland by securing Durotar's bedrock and rooting out demonic collaborators beneath the capital.
As a tauren, you know Magatha Grimtotem sent emissaries to seek peace with the invading troggs. Their bloody refusal showed that diplomacy could not stop these underground beasts.
